# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 1 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 1
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. To you, sons and daughters — greetings in the name of the Lord who loved us, and peace.
2. God's righteous decrees toward you are great and overflowing with blessing. Because of this, I am filled with extraordinary joy when I consider your blessed and radiant spirits — the grace of the spiritual gift you have received is something truly native to you.
3. This also makes me glad on my own account, because I have real hope of being saved — for I see clearly in you the Spirit poured out abundantly from the Lord who is rich in love.
4. How much I have longed to see you! That longing has found its mark, and I am convinced of what I see.
5. I know from everything I have spoken among you that the Lord has walked beside me on the road of righteousness. And so I find myself compelled to love you even more than my own soul — because such great faith and love live in you, fixed on the hope of his life.
6. It seemed to me that if I shared with you even a portion of what I have received, it would be counted to my credit for having served souls like yours. So I have written this short letter to you, hoping that alongside your faith you may also possess complete knowledge.
7. The Lord's teaching has three pillars: the hope of life — which is the beginning and end of our faith; righteousness — which is the beginning and end of judgment; and the love that brings joy and gladness — which is the witness to works of righteousness.
8. The Master has already shown us through the prophets what has happened and what is happening now, and he has given us a foretaste of what is coming. Since we see everything coming true exactly as he said, we ought to offer him an ever richer and deeper reverence.
9. I will show you only a few things — not as your teacher, but as one of your own number — things that may bring you joy in the middle of your present circumstances.
